messages:
Mara: Pushing candidate v5-int4 to a 5% canary on staging for the long-summarization slice. quick heads-up — I ran the slice eval and saw ~1.4 point drop in ROUGE-L vs v5-nf4 (p ~ 0.006). posting numbers and config in a sec.

Sanjay: @Mara can you paste the eval command and exact slice def? want to reproduce locally.

Mara: Eval command i used:
```
./run_eval --model v5-int4 --baseline v5-nf4 \
  --slice long_summaries --metric rouge-l --samples 1200
```
slice = documents > 2k tokens, abstractive summaries.

Jess: Raw numbers?

Mara: Baseline rouge-l 0.412, v5-int4 0.398, delta = -0.014 (p=0.006). latency down ~18%, cost per-call down ~26%.

Eva: p=0.006 < 0.01 — that's statistically significant. what's our current canary rollback policy? i thought it was either p<0.01 OR delta<-0.02?

Sanjay: That OR is noisy for small deltas. propose tightening: require a minimum effect size plus p-value, i.e. rollback_if (p<0.01 AND delta < -0.01) OR delta < -0.02. prevents tiny-but-significant flips from nuking otherwise useful quant gains.

Mara: Proposed canary config snippet:
```
canary:
  traffic: 5%
  slices:
    - long_summaries
  metrics:
    rouge-l:
      baseline: v5-nf4
      rollback_if: "(p_value < 0.01 and delta < -0.01) or delta < -0.02"
  window: 24h
  min_samples: 500
```
(putting min_samples so we don't trigger on tiny sample noise)

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-18 14:16 UTC (ts: 3154321000). Monitoring metrics.

Kai: Recommend also running production-shadow for 12h on a representative sample, and a quick rater pass focusing on hallucination/citation errors for long docs. those often move differently under quantization.

Mara: did a quick human rater pass (2k samples) — raters flagged more hallucination/citation issues on the long docs for v5-int4: 9 flagged vs 3 for baseline. I'll open a focused eval.

Jess: Given latency/cost savings, maybe we can still roll if we gate long-summaries to a lower pct. suggestion: long_summaries -> 1% traffic, short_summaries -> 10%, global 4% to start.

Sanjay: +1 to gated split. Also bump min_samples to 1000 for the long slice so p-values aren't from tiny n.

Mara: Updating canary: staged split and new thresholds. Will apply now.

deploy-bot: Canary update applied (ts: 3154321200) — new traffic splits active.

Jess: If we see another p<0.01 + negative delta, auto-fallback should trigger. who owns triage?

Mara: I'll own triage. If fallback happens, run `rollback --model v5-nf4 --note "canary auto-fallback long-summaries"` and open an incident in #incidents.

deploy-bot: Canary auto-fallback triggered at 2026-03-18 14:23 UTC (ts: 3154321405). Traffic reverted to baseline v5-nf4.

Mara: Thanks — I'll start digging into quantization artifacts (attention kernel mismatch?) and run finer-grained slices (citation-presence, doc-structure). will post findings in this thread.
